state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

name: auto_brightness
description: Turn adaptive brightness on or off.

state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

description: Set the screen brightness.

level.description: A percentage from 0 to 100, or up, down, max or min.

name: volume
description: Change the media volume.

name: media
description: Control whatever music or video is playing.

name: call
description: Phone a contact or number. The user confirms before it dials.

contact.description: A contact name or a phone number.

name: send_sms
description: Send a text message. The user confirms before it is sent.

contact.description: A contact name or a phone number.

text.description: Recipient and message together, when they could not be split.

name: set_alarm
description: Set an alarm in the clock app.

name: set_timer
description: Start a countdown timer in the clock app.

seconds.description: Length of the timer in seconds.

name: open_app
description: Open an installed app by name.

name.description: The app's name as shown in the launcher.

name: navigate
description: Get directions to a place in the maps app.

name: quick_setting
description: Turn a Quick Settings tile on or off, or tap it, by the name shown on it (battery saver, night light, extra dim, data saver, screen record and so on). Needs phone control turned on.

state.description: Whether to turn it on or off.

name: set_reminder
description: Remind the user of something at a time, with a notification.

when.description: When, as said: in 20 minutes, at 6pm, tomorrow at 9.

name: calendar_events
description: Tell what's on the calendar for a day, or the coming week.

day.description: Today, tomorrow, a weekday, a date, or week.

name: add_event
description: Add an event to the calendar app; the user saves it there.

when.description: Day and time, as said: Friday at 3, tomorrow.

name: read_notifications
description: Read out recent notifications and messages, optionally only from one app or person.

from.description: An app or person to read from.

name: reply_message
description: Reply to a message notification, through the app it came from. The user confirms first.

contact.description: Who to reply to; empty for the latest message.

name: phone_action
description: Take a screenshot, lock the phone, or go home, back, to recent apps, the notifications or the power menu.

name: weather
description: Tell the weather now, for a day, or for the week, here or in a named place.

place.description: A city or place; empty for where the phone is.

day.description: Today, tomorrow, a weekday, a date, or week.

name: open_settings
description: Open a settings page, or an app's App info page.

app.description: An app, for its App info page.

name: camera
description: Open the camera to take a photo, a selfie, or a video.

name: contact_info
description: Tell a contact's phone number, email, address or birthday.

name: send_email
description: Start an email in the email app; the user sends it there.

contact.description: A contact name or email address.

name: add_note
description: Save a note or list item in the notes app.

name: play_music
description: Play a song, artist, album, playlist or genre in the music app.

artist.description: The artist, for a song or album.

app.description: A music app to play it in.

name: alarms
description: Tell when the next alarm is, show the alarms, or turn one off.

hour.description: The alarm's hour (0-23), to turn off a particular one.

ambiguous.description: true when am or pm wasn't said.

name: timers
description: Tell how long is left on a timer, or show or cancel the timers.

name: reminders
description: List the reminders, or cancel one or all of them.

which.description: Words from the reminder to cancel, or all.

name: call_log
description: Tell who called: missed or recent calls.

name: call_back
description: Call back the last person who called. The user confirms first.

name: remember
description: Remember a fact about the user for later.

name: forget
description: Forget something remembered, or everything.

what.description: Words from what to forget, or all.

name: recall
description: Say what Shuttle remembers about the user.

name: battery_status
description: Report the battery level and whether the phone is charging.

name: web_search
description: Search the web and read the top results.

name: status
description: Tell whether a setting is on, or its current level. Offers to switch it.

setting.description: Which setting, or all for a summary.

name: date_time
description: Tell the current time or date.
